sanskrit:
मानापमानयो स्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः ।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते ॥ १४-२५॥
iast:
mānāpamānayostulya stulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ
sarvārambhaparityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate 14-25
translation: The same in honour and dishonour; the same to friend and foe; abandoning all undertakings — he is said to have crossed beyond the GUNAS.
